articles.titleZh: 每天 10 分钟，陪孩子用 AI 练英语讲故事
articles.titleEn: Ten minutes a day: practise English storytelling with AI
articles.answerZh: 家长拿手机，孩子开口讲，AI 只负责提问。重点不是听 AI 讲故事，而是让孩子自己把故事讲出来。
articles.answerEn: The parent holds the phone, the child tells the story, and AI only asks questions. The point is for your child to do the talking.
articles.whoZh: 6 到 12 岁、已经能说简单英语句子的孩子，以及愿意陪 10 分钟的家长。家长英语不流利也能带。
articles.whoEn: Children aged 6 to 12 who can say simple English sentences, with a parent who can sit beside them for 10 minutes. Parents do not need strong English.
articles.noteZh: 先说清楚：ChatGPT 要求用户至少 13 岁，所以账号和手机都由家长使用，孩子只和家长说话。其他 AI 工具请先看各自的年龄规定。AI 可能出错，内容要家长把关，这个方法也不保证提分。
articles.noteEn: Important: ChatGPT users must be at least 13, so the parent keeps the account and the phone, and the child talks only to the parent. Check the age rules of any other AI tool. AI can make mistakes, so stay involved. This method does not promise better grades.
factsZh: 选题（1 分钟）：孩子选主角、地点和一个麻烦。
共创（5 分钟）：孩子说一句，家长复述给 AI，再把 AI 的问题读给孩子。情节由孩子决定。
复述（2 分钟）：孩子不看提示，把故事从头讲一遍。这一步最重要。
升级（1 分钟）：AI 表扬一个具体优点，只给一个改进点。
收尾（1 分钟）：孩子用三句话说出开头、中间和结尾。
factsEn: Choose (1 minute): your child picks a hero, a place and a problem.
Build (5 minutes): your child says a line, you repeat it to AI, then read its question aloud. Your child decides the plot.
Retell (2 minutes): your child tells the whole story without prompts. This is the most important step.
Improve (1 minute): AI gives one specific piece of praise and one small next step.
Finish (1 minute): your child sums up the beginning, middle and end in three sentences.
actionsZh: 手机在家长手里，孩子不单独使用。
只用昵称，不说真实姓名、学校、住址、照片或家庭细节。
关闭记忆功能，或使用临时对话。
不生成分享链接，因为里面可能有孩子的故事和个人信息。
定好结束时间，10 分钟到就停。
actionsEn: Keep the phone in your hands. Your child does not use it alone.
Use a nickname. Do not share real names, school, address, photos or family details.
Turn memory off or use a temporary chat.
Do not create share links, which could expose your child's stories or details.
Set an end time and stop at 10 minutes.

prompts.titleZh: 第一步：先发这段（把方括号换成你的信息）
prompts.titleEn: Step 1: send this first (fill in the brackets)
prompts.text:
You are Story Partner, a warm and playful English storytelling coach.

SETUP
I am the parent and the only person using this account. My child, nicknamed [NICKNAME], is [AGE] years old and is sitting beside me. I will repeat my child's words to you. Write every reply so I can read it aloud to my child.
English level: [BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / CONFIDENT]
Today's mode: [MODE, or "free story"]

YOUR GOAL
Help my child do most of the talking and build the story. You are the helper, not the author.

RULES
1. Keep each reply to 2 short sentences at most.
2. Ask exactly one question per reply, then stop and wait.
3. Never add a major plot event, character, or ending unless my child asks for help.
4. Prefer open questions such as "What happens next?" or "How does she feel?"
5. Offer two choices only if my child is stuck.
6. Do not correct every mistake. Naturally repeat the sentence in correct English, then continue.
7. Use words suited to this age. Introduce at most one new word per session.
8. Keep content gentle: no scary, violent, romantic, or unsafe themes.
9. Never ask for real names, school, location, photos, or personal details. If my child shares any, do not repeat it and steer back to the story.
10. Do not act as my child's friend or encourage more screen time.

SESSION FLOW
A. Ask for a hero, a place, and a problem, one at a time.
B. Build the story together for about 6 turns.
C. Say: "Now you tell the whole story, from the beginning!" Then only listen.
D. Give one specific praise and one small next step.
E. Ask my child to say the story in three sentences: beginning, middle, end.
F. End warmly and tell us it is time to stop.

Start now with one short, fun question.
Mode: Three Words. Give 3 random, funny words. My child must use all 3 in a story.
Mode: Hero Problem. Guide who, where, problem, attempt, solution.
Mode: Sentence Relay. Add one small sentence after each of my child's sentences. Never resolve the problem.

prompts.titleZh: 家长英语不自信？再加这段
prompts.titleEn: Less confident in English? Add this
prompts.text: Parent support: My English is not strong. I may speak to you in Chinese. In every reply, first give me one short note in Simplified Chinese labeled 家长提示. Then give one simple English line labeled Read aloud. Do not ask me to correct my child's pronunciation.

articles.titleZh: Fairfield Park 地下要修污水池，住附近要知道什么？
articles.titleEn: Wastewater tanks under Fairfield Park: what neighbours should know
articles.answerZh: 水务公司 IAWAI 计划在 Fairfield Park 西南角地下修两座污水调蓄池，第一座预计 2028 年开工。有意见的话，12 月 11 日前可以提交。
articles.answerEn: Water company IAWAI plans two underground wastewater tanks at the south-west end of Fairfield Park, with work on the first expected in 2028. Submissions close on 11 December.
articles.whoZh: 住在 Fairfield、Heaphy Terrace 一带，或者常去这个公园散步、遛狗的人。
articles.whoEn: People living around Fairfield and Heaphy Terrace, and anyone who walks or exercises a dog in the park.
factsZh: 第一座容积 4000 立方米，预计 2028 年开工，工期 18 个月到两年。
第二座容积 2000 立方米，至少 10 年后才装，要看实际需求。
项目范围共 11,310 平方米，临 Heaphy Terrace；运动场和休闲设施在公园中部，不在施工区内。
要移除 9 棵树、修剪 4 棵，施工期间步道要绕行。
水池平时是空的，只在下大雨、管网撑不住时启用，用来减少污水溢流。维护时公园里可能闻到轻微气味。
报告没有列出造价。
factsEn: The first tank holds 4,000 m³. Work is expected in 2028 and should take 18 months to two years.
The second holds 2,000 m³ and would not be installed for at least 10 years, depending on demand.
The designated area is 11,310 m² fronting Heaphy Terrace. Sports fields and recreation facilities are in the central part of the park, away from the site.
Nine trees would be removed and four trimmed, and walking routes would be diverted during construction.
The tanks stay empty until wet weather overwhelms the network, reducing the risk of overflows. Maintenance could cause low levels of odour in the park.
The report did not include a cost estimate.
actionsZh: 住得近或常去公园，先看看施工位置会不会影响你的路线。
担心噪音、气味、树木或步道，可以向 Hamilton City Council 提交意见，入口在下面的 1News 报道里。
提交截止日期是 12 月 11 日。
actionsEn: If you live nearby or use the park, check how the site affects your route.
If noise, odour, trees or paths concern you, make a submission to Hamilton City Council. The 1News report below links to it.

articles.titleZh: 第一关：刚落地，这 5 件事先办
articles.titleEn: Level 1: just landed? Sort these five things first
articles.answerZh: 先办税号和银行账户，尽早登记家庭医生，驾照和社区服务卡按自己的情况办。
articles.answerEn: Get your IRD number and bank account first, enrol with a GP early, then handle your licence and Community Services Card as they apply to you.
articles.whoZh: 刚到新西兰，或者到了一阵子但这些事还没办完的人。
articles.whoEn: New arrivals, and anyone who has been here a while with some of this still unfinished.
factsZh: 税号（IRD）：按新抵埠流程在 myIR 申请，获批后 2 天内以短信或邮件收到。
银行账户：以 ANZ 为例，网上填表，按邮件补材料，到分行核验身份后才能完整使用。
家庭医生：符合资格的人登记免费，但可能最长要 3 个月，别等生病才办。
驾照：中国大陆驾照走非豁免流程，首次全部通过的官方费用合计 157.70 纽币，翻译费另算。
社区服务卡：看居留身份和家庭收入，符合条件可以申请。
factsEn: IRD number: apply through myIR using the new-arrival process. Approved numbers arrive by text or email within 2 days.
Bank account: using ANZ as an example, fill in the online form, send the documents requested, then verify your identity at a branch for full access.
GP: enrolment is free for eligible people but can take up to 3 months, so do it before you get sick.
Licence: mainland China licences use the non-exempt process. Official fees total NZ$157.70 if you pass everything first time, with translation extra.
Community Services Card: depends on residence and household income.
actionsZh: 打开网站的「新移民清单」，每一步要带什么材料都写好了。
办完一件划掉一件，优先把税号给雇主。
actionsEn: Open the Arrival checklist on this site for the documents each step needs.
Tick them off as you go, and give your employer your IRD number first.

articles.titleZh: 圣诞季市中心免费停车，别白交钱
articles.titleEn: Free central city parking this festive season
articles.answerZh: 11 月底到节礼日，Garden Place 停车场有 5 天免费（其中 2 天从下午 3 点起），12 月 21 日至 24 日下午 3 点后路边短时车位也免费。
articles.answerEn: Garden Place Car Park is free on five days up to Boxing Day (two of them from 3pm), and on-street short-stay parking is free after 3pm from 21 to 24 December.
articles.whoZh: 圣诞前后要去市中心购物、吃饭、看圣诞树的人。
articles.whoEn: Anyone heading into the central city to shop, eat out or see the Christmas tree.
factsZh: Garden Place 停车场：11 月 28 日、12 月 5 日，下午 3 点到午夜免费。
Garden Place 停车场：12 月 19 日、24 日、26 日，早 6 点到午夜免费。节礼日免费是第一次。
路边短时收费车位：12 月 21 日至 24 日，每天下午 3 点后免费。
公众假期路边停车也免费，但仍要遵守路牌上的限制。
factsEn: Garden Place Car Park: free from 3pm to midnight on 28 November and 5 December.
Garden Place Car Park: free from 6am to midnight on 19, 24 and 26 December. Boxing Day is a first.
On-street short-stay paid parking: free after 3pm each day from 21 to 24 December.
On-street parking is also free on public holidays, subject to posted restrictions.
actionsZh: 能晚点去就下午 3 点后到。
3 点前到的话平时规则照旧，包括要登记两小时免费停车。
actionsEn: Before 3pm the normal rules apply, including registering for two hours of free parking.

news.titleZh: Marian Catholic School 营地后爆发肠胃炎
news.titleEn: Gastro outbreak after Marian Catholic School camp
news.bodyZh: 国家公共卫生服务（National Public Health Service）说，11 月 18 日至 20 日在怀卡托（Waikato）举行的 Marian Catholic School 营地约有 400 多人参加，之后多名学生、家长和至少两名老师上吐下泻，没去营地的家人也有人被传染，原因还在查。
news.bodyEn: The National Public Health Service says a number of students, parents and at least two staff fell ill after the Marian Catholic School camp on 18 to 20 November, attended by more than 400 people. Some household members who did not go have also been sick, and the cause is still being investigated.
news.takeZh: 家里有人上吐下泻，症状停了 48 小时再去上学上班；不放心就打 Healthline 0800 611 116，免费。
news.takeEn: Anyone with gastro should stay home until 48 hours after symptoms stop. Healthline is free on 0800 611 116.

news.titleZh: SuperGold 卡高峰时段免费坐公交，可能保留
news.titleEn: Free peak-hour buses for SuperGold holders may stay
news.bodyZh: 怀卡托区域议会（Waikato Regional Council）8 月曾打算取消，遭居民强烈反对。现在公共交通小组委员会建议保留工作日早 7 点到 9 点、下午 3 点到 6 点半的免费乘车，还要等议员最终批准。
news.bodyEn: Waikato Regional Council had signalled in August that it would axe the scheme, but after strong opposition its public transport subcommittee now recommends keeping free weekday travel from 7am to 9am and 3pm to 6.30pm. Councillors still need to approve it.
news.takeZh: 家里老人高峰时段坐车去医院的，先照常坐，等议会最后拍板。
news.takeEn: Older family members can keep riding at peak times for now while councillors decide.

news.titleZh: 三家 Woolworths 门口的 ATM 被撤了
news.titleEn: ATMs removed at three Waikato Woolworths stores
news.bodyZh: 西太平洋银行（Westpac）以需求下降为由，撤走了 Bridge St、Te Rapa 和蒂阿瓦穆图（Te Awamutu）三家 Woolworths 的 ATM。Woolworths 说正在和新的服务商安装替代 ATM。
news.bodyEn: Westpac has removed the ATMs at the Bridge St, Te Rapa and Te Awamutu Woolworths stores, citing falling demand. Woolworths says it is working with a new provider to install replacements.
news.takeZh: 需要现金的，先别指望超市门口那台了，提前在别处取好。
news.takeEn: If you need cash, get it elsewhere before you go shopping.

news.titleZh: 严重厄尔尼诺可能要来，怀卡托提前备水
news.titleEn: Waikato prepares its water supply for El Niño
news.bodyZh: 水务公司 IAWAI 担心干旱让怀卡托河水位下降，已备好一艘驳船当浮动泵站，也准备了限水方案，必要时家庭用水也要配合。
news.bodyEn: Water company IAWAI is preparing for low river levels, with a barge ready as a floating pump station and water restriction plans that could include households.
news.takeZh: 今年夏天洗车、浇花可以先省着点，别等限水了才改习惯。
news.takeEn: Go easy on car washing and garden watering before restrictions force the change.

news.titleZh: Garden Place 的 27 米圣诞树，今年可能是最后一次
news.titleEn: Garden Place's 27 m Christmas tree may be in its last year
news.bodyZh: 支撑圣诞树的钢架已焊修多次，专家认为不能继续用。更换报价约 22 万到 25 万纽币，除非有人出资，今年可能就是最后一次。今年的点灯节在 11 月 28 日（周六）下午 5 点到 9 点，地点花园广场（Garden Place）；当天下午 3 点到午夜，市议会的 Garden Place 停车场免费。
news.bodyEn: Experts say the repeatedly welded steel frame is no longer safe to reuse. A replacement is quoted at NZ$220,000 to NZ$250,000, so this may be its last year unless someone funds it. This year's lighting festival is in Garden Place on Saturday 28 November, 5pm to 9pm, and the council's Garden Place Car Park is free from 3pm to midnight that day.
news.takeZh: 想带孩子看点灯的，3 点后开进 Garden Place 停车场，停车不花钱。
news.takeEn: Taking the kids to the lighting? Park at Garden Place after 3pm for free.

news.titleZh: Hillcrest 图书馆开始招设计团队，目标 2028 年重开
news.titleEn: Hillcrest Library seeks a design team, aiming to reopen in 2028
news.bodyZh: 图书馆去年因火灾受损。市议会正在招标设计，项目估算 500 万到 700 万纽币，12 月 11 日截标，预计 2027 年动工。
news.bodyEn: The library was damaged by fire last year. The council is tendering for design on a project estimated at NZ$5 million to NZ$7 million. Tenders close on 11 December, with construction expected in 2027.
news.takeZh: 这还只是估算，等设计出来才知道最后要花多少。
news.takeEn: This is still an estimate. The real bill comes after the design.

news.titleZh: Ngāruawāhia 段高速施工，去奥克兰多留时间
news.titleEn: Expressway works at Ngāruawāhia: allow extra time
news.bodyZh: SH1 Waikato Expressway 的 Ngaruawahia 路段因路面修复，双向各缩为 1 条车道，限速 50 和 70 公里。预计从 11 月 23 日起持续约 2 周。
news.bodyEn: Pavement repairs have reduced the SH1 Ngaruawahia section to one lane each way, with 50 and 70 km/h limits, for about two weeks from 23 November.
news.takeZh: 高峰期去奥克兰或赶飞机，记得早点出门。
news.takeEn: Leave earlier for Auckland or the airport at peak times.

news.titleZh: 去 Raglan 的路上有施工
news.titleEn: Roadworks on the way to Raglan
news.bodyZh: SH23 Whatawhata 的 Ferguson Road 和 Wallace Road 路口附近有停走管制，临时限速 30 公里。
news.bodyEn: SH23 at Whatawhata has stop/go traffic management near Ferguson Road and Wallace Road, with a temporary 30 km/h limit.
news.takeZh: 周末去海边，出发前看一眼路况。
news.takeEn: Check the road before a weekend beach trip.

news.titleZh: 产粮大区，却有三分之一的人吃饭成问题
news.titleEn: A food-producing region where a third struggle to eat
news.bodyZh: NZ Food Network 的报告显示，怀卡托有 36% 的人更容易面临食物短缺。Vinnies Hamilton 今年开了社会超市，这家机构每年为近 5 万人提供食物。
news.bodyEn: A NZ Food Network report found 36% of people in Waikato are more likely to face food insecurity. Vinnies Hamilton opened a social supermarket this year and feeds almost 50,000 people annually.
news.takeZh: 手头紧不丢人，真有需要可以找这类机构。
news.takeEn: There is no shame in asking for help when money is tight.

news.titleZh: 30 年区域规划要来，账单可能落到 rates 上
news.titleEn: A 30-year regional plan could land on ratepayers
news.bodyZh: 政府要求怀卡托 11 个议会共同做区域空间规划，费用可能达 3000 万纽币。汉密尔顿议员担心时间太赶，也担心本市分摊最多。草案须在 2028 年 6 月前公布。
news.bodyEn: Eleven Waikato councils must produce a regional spatial plan that could cost NZ$30 million. Hamilton councillors are worried about the timeline and the city's share. A draft is due by June 2028.
news.takeZh: 有房的朋友可以留意后面的 rates 讨论。
news.takeEn: Homeowners should watch the coming rates discussion.

news.titleZh: 夏季海滩水质检测开始了，下水前先查
news.titleEn: Summer beach water testing has begun
news.bodyZh: 怀卡托地区议会到明年 3 月底检测 9 处海滩和 4 个河口，包括 Raglan 的 Ngarunui Beach。议会提醒河口水质波动更大，下雨后尤其要注意。
news.bodyEn: Waikato Regional Council will test nine beaches and four estuaries until the end of March, including Ngarunui Beach in Raglan. Estuaries vary more, especially after rain.
news.takeZh: 带孩子玩水前看一眼 LAWA，下过雨就更要查。
news.takeEn: Check LAWA before the kids swim, especially after rain.
